title: Melody and bass specialist paths - separated stem -> monophonic pitch tracking -> segmentation -> tracker fusion, measured against exact truth and the canonical melody gate (ANALYSIS ENGINE stream G, PR-88)
principle: A melody is a line one voice sang, not everything that sounds. Each path is measured against exact truth on the same audio, and its acceptance is measured under the platform's own gate, alone and beside today's full-mix Basic Pitch. UNKNOWN is a valid answer; disagreement is recorded, never averaged; nothing here is promoted.

separation.family: Hybrid Transformer Demucs v4 (Meta, MIT licence)

crepe.implementation: torchcrepe (CREPE, Kim et al. 2018; PyTorch port by Max Morrison, MIT licence)

basic_pitch.implementation: Spotify Basic Pitch 0.4.0 (Apache-2.0), ONNX Runtime backend

worker.licencePosition: All components are permissively licensed (MIT / Apache-2.0). This is an analysis worker: nothing here generates music and nothing here is a product route; it exists so a melody or bass line can be measured before it is trusted.

baselineProvider.path: runAnalysisProviders (sourceAnalyzer's own call) with only BASIC_PITCH configured; the melody is fuseCanonicalNotes on that one result, exactly as the Song Model is built today

exactTier.corpus: ANALYSIS_GOLD_V1 SYNTHETIC_EXACT (Stream H, PR-81): composed works rendered stem by stem with the platform's deterministic renderer; every note is known
exactTier.leadRule: the highest-lying pitched non-bass track is the melody truth (role recorded per work); overlapping tails are trimmed to the next onset; the bass track is the bass truth

method.realTier: the owner's uploads: no truth; outputs, validator acceptance and disagreement only
method.melodyStemChoice: vocals when the separated vocal stem is above -40 dBFS RMS and within 12 dB of the other stem, else other (no truth consulted)
method.scoring: one-to-one greedy onset matching at 50 ms; onset+pitch requires the exact MIDI pitch; offset within max(50 ms, 20 % of the true duration); voicing and pitch on a 10 ms frame grid; octave error = onset-matched pairs off by exactly 12 or 24 semitones
method.gate: fuseCanonicalNotes: note confidence x result confidence x reliability (MELODY_STEM_PATH_V1 0.9), sole-provider floor 0.85; beside BASIC_PITCH a note both heard at the same onset (30 ms) and end (50 ms) with the same pitch is admitted on two votes; then validateMelody
